concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-gateway-rejections]] — gateway-setting rejection versus customer-bank decline, pre-processor and post-authorization rejection timing, automatic void behavior, bank-acknowledgment warning, and `Gateway Rejected` reason routing
warnings: Keep this as gateway behavior documented by a Control Panel article; do not imply that an operator manually performs the rejection or void in the Control Panel.
Do not equate authorization with capture, settlement submission, final settlement, or funding.
Preserve the warning that a bank may delay or never acknowledge the automatic void.
Do not import decline classifications or behavior from the unread Declines article; it is navigation only.
Treat the 2026-09-16 raw as collected evidence, not proof of current support or settings.
